name: undersigned
title: Undersigned
description: A campaign theme whose home page is a photocopied petition sheet: the demand in heavy black capitals, the running total in a box at the top, then numbered ruled lines swiped in highlighter yellow that lead to volunteering, donating and every way to help.

tokens.--font-display: heavy grotesque for the demand, headings, the running total, the site title, table figures and labels
tokens.--font-body: transitional serif for body text, the petition text, ledes and the numbered lines
tokens.--text-s: small print: dates, column heads, the footer, the unit in the running total
tokens.--text-m: body text and the site title
tokens.--text-l: ledes, the petition text, the links on the numbered lines and table figures
tokens.--text-xl: section headings (h2) and the titles in lists; stays above --text-l at every width
tokens.--text-demand: the demand on the home page petition sheet, set in capitals
tokens.--text-tally: the number in the running-total box
tokens.--leading-tight: line height of headings and the demand
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter-spacing of small capital labels and column heads
tokens.--color-text: toner-black text, headings and the focus ring
tokens.--color-muted: the line numbers, dates and secondary text
tokens.--color-accent: the bar under the current menu entry
tokens.--color-link: link text: black by day, highlighter yellow at night
tokens.--color-highlight: the highlighter stroke behind every link and the numbered lines; a faint yellow wash at night
tokens.--color-rule: the sheet frame, ruled lines, table rules and every border
tokens.--color-toner: the toner shadow down both edges of the page
tokens.--color-haze: the soft inner edge and streaks of the toner shadow, and the scroll shadow on wide tables
tokens.--space-3: spacing scale: base, and the side gutter
tokens.--line-height: height of one numbered ruled line on the sheet
tokens.--line-no: width of the number column on the ruled lines and lists
tokens.--edge-width: width of the streaky toner shadow down both edges of the page
tokens.--sign-col: width of the signature column on the home page petition sheet
tokens.--rule-heavy: thickness of the sheet frame and of the heavy rules under headings
